text:
Choosing between HDHP and PPO plan

I know a lot of people ask this this time of year but I’m really just needing someone to double check my work in trying to figure out which plan is best for me. 
 I’m a type 1 diabetic with a newborn on the way. All calculations will be based on my medical costs for this past year since I will just be guessing on the baby’s medical. 
 Last year on a PPO plan:
 Deductible: $1,750 (only medical claims go towards deductible)
 Total out of pocket spent after insurance: $2,705.39. I did get a new insulin pump that was $1,456 which is not an every year expense. 
 This year PPO plan (2027):
 Deductible: $1,750/$3,500 (only medical claims go towards deductible)
 OOPM: $4,000/$8,000
 Premium: $311.12 x 26=$8,089.12
 Coinsurance: 10%
 Estimating I would spend $1,880 on medical for the year for me alone. 
 $8,089.12+$1,750+$13($1,880-$1,750=$130 x10%)
 Total estimated spending = $11,359.96
 HDHP Plan (2027):
 Deductible: $3,500/$7,000 (both medical and pharmacy claims go towards deductible)
 OOPM: $6,000/$7,000
 Premium: $87.63 x 26 =$2,278.38
 Coinsurance: 20%
 HSA: $300 x 26=$7,800.00 (Employer contributes $1,200)
 Estimating I would spend $9,756.08 across both medical and pharmacy. 
 Total estimated spending:
 $87.63 x 26 =$2,278.38
 $9,756.08-$3,500=$6,256.08
 $6,256.08 x 20% =$1,251.22
